info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Capital Markets Management API
info.description: The Capital Markets Management API enables financial institutions to update and manage wholesale trading activities within the capital markets. This endpoint allows for the modification of specific trading parameters, enhancing operational flexibility. Typical consumers include trading desks and financial analysts who require dynamic adjustments to trading strategies. Through this API, users can ensure compliance with market changes and optimize trading performance efficiently.
